name: herdr
description: Teaches an agent to use Herdr, the terminal workspace manager for coding agents: start worktrees and agents, prompt them safely, listen to their work and act as an orchestrator. Standalone and thin over the herdr CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Start, prompt and listen to agents in Herdr worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Herdr skills for coding agents running inside Herdr: start a worktree with agents on it, start an agent in a pane, send prompts without duplicates, listen to agents and surface the questions they are blocked on, and take the orchestrator role. Requires the herdr CLI and a Herdr-managed pane.
defaultPrompt: Start a Herdr worktree with an agent on it.
Listen to the agents in this worktree.
